name: qhy-draw
description: Cross-platform draw.io / diagrams.net diagram generator, adapted from bruc3van/bruce-drawio. Use when user wants to create any diagram: flowchart, architecture, UML (sequence/class), ER, mindmap, network topology. Trigger: draw diagram, flowchart, architecture diagram, UML, sequence diagram, mindmap, ER diagram, network topology, visualize, draw.io, drawio. Workflow: LLM generates drawio XML -> self-review -> save .drawio -> CLI export PNG/SVG/PDF. Supports Windows, macOS, Linux.
author: brucevanfdm@gmail.com; adapted for qhy-skills
